data.label: GovernmentCapex
data.thesis: India's infrastructure push — multi-decade capex cycle across roads, railways, defence, and power. Government remains the primary demand driver.

data.label: ManufacturingTailwind
data.thesis: PLI schemes + China+1 supply chain diversification driving domestic manufacturing across electronics, chemicals, and textiles.

data.label: FutureEconomy
data.thesis: Digital infrastructure, EV transition, speciality materials, and healthcare infrastructure — long runway, early innings.

data.label: InfraCapex
data.thesis: Road, rail, port, and urban infra build-out. Order books visible 2–3 years ahead. Execution risk is the key variable.

data.label: Defence
data.thesis: Atmanirbhar Bharat defence indigenisation. DPP + export ambitions. Long order visibility. DRDO transfers to private sector accelerating.

data.label: PowerCapex
data.thesis: Transmission + renewable addition target 500 GW by 2030. T&D capex and generation build-out running in parallel.

data.label: Railways
data.thesis: ₹2.5L Cr annual railway budget. Dedicated freight corridors, Vande Bharat, metro rail. Multi-year order pipeline for rolling stock, signalling, and infra.

data.label: Roads
data.thesis: NHAI + state road capex. High execution risk, competitive tendering. Prefer EPC players with strong balance sheets.

data.label: Ports
data.thesis: Sagarmala programme + export-led growth. Mechanisation and capacity expansion driving equipment demand.

data.label: Defence_Electronics
data.thesis: Radars, avionics, electronic warfare, C4ISR systems. High-margin, long-cycle. Preferred route for indigenisation.

data.label: Defence_Platforms
data.thesis: Aircraft, ships, submarines, armoured vehicles. DPSU + private JVs. Long lead times but transformative order sizes.

data.label: Defence_MRO
data.thesis: Maintenance, repair, overhaul for ageing fleet. Annuity-like recurring revenue once qualified. Under-tracked opportunity.

data.label: PowerT&D
data.thesis: Transmission lines, substations, smart meters, cables. Demand driven by both new generation capacity and grid modernisation.

data.label: RenewableEnergy
data.thesis: Solar + wind + green hydrogen. Equipment manufacturers, EPC players, and balance-of-plant suppliers all benefit.

data.label: PLI_Electronics
data.thesis: Mobile + components + IT hardware PLI. Apple supply chain anchor. EMS players scaling to global standards.

data.label: PLI_Chemicals
data.thesis: Pharma + specialty chemical PLI. China+1 demand pull. API, CRAMS, agrochemicals benefiting from capacity addition.

data.label: China+1_Textiles
data.thesis: Global sourcing shift from China for garments + technical textiles. Requires scale and compliance infrastructure.

data.label: Semiconductor
data.thesis: India Semiconductor Mission. Early-stage but strategic. Packaging + ATMP first; fab longer-term. High geopolitical tailwind.

data.label: DataCentre
data.thesis: AI + cloud + digital India driving 30%+ CAGR in data centre capacity. Power, cooling, UPS, and cable suppliers benefit.

data.label: EV_Components
data.thesis: EV penetration accelerating in 2W, 3W, and buses first. Battery management, motors, and charging infra supply chain.

data.label: SpecialtyChemicals
data.thesis: High-complexity, low-volume chemicals with pricing power. Agrochemicals, dyes, CRAMS, fluorochemicals. China+1 + CDMO model.

data.label: Hospitals_HealthcareInfra
data.thesis: Under-bedded India building 1M+ hospital beds. Medical devices, diagnostics, and hospital chains all in multi-year capex.
